title: Rene's drum novelties, sleigh bells and Celestin firing a drummer
summary: Rene describes a showy drummer, Celestin firing him, and Rene's own bag of novelty effects used while keeping time.

See fellas always did try to outdo one another, you know. And I used to have me a whole box of Cetron. I had a piece about that out and about that wide and had a little snare drum to me. And I had all kinds of things, coconut shells, sandpaper, all kinds of different little horn I'd buy at the 10-cent store. I'd make all kinds of foolishness, you know. But I'd still hold my time, though. I'd blow that stuff in between there, but I'd never turn my time loose. Because when I got ready to use that stuff like that, I'd use it in my left hand. And I'd just brush with one brush or two brushes with my right hand. I'd keep that rhythm going, but I'd use that stuff in between there. That's what I did.
